label: Bible Study
prompt: Thou wilt keep him in perfect _____, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verse: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
note: The Hebrew doubles it — 'shalom shalom': peace, and then peace again.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as _____.
verse: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
note: Job can't see God anywhere in his trial — but trusts he'll come out the far side as gold.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as _____, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verse: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
note: God's courtroom invitation: sins dyed scarlet, promised white as snow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Cast thy _____ upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verse: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
note: The Preacher's case for generous risk: release it now, and it comes back with interest — eventually.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Whom God hath set forth to be a _____ through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verse: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
note: The great atonement word: a sacrifice that satisfies. Every seminarian's flashcard, right here.
